lede: The biggest item this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where first reading of Land Use Code amendments tied to Colorado's wildfire resilience requirements goes on the table — changes to how buildings get built in a box canyon that knows fire. The same evening, the Telluride Housing Authority appoints members to its new Resident Advisory Committee, drawing from fifteen tenant applications across Town properties. The Open Space Commission walks Reach 1 of the Valley Floor Monday afternoon to eyeball real trail alignments along the river.

notable.stake: First reading of wildfire-resilience Land Use Code changes affects how all buildings are built here.
